answer: An agent claims a cedar plot in the oasis census, locks 70 credits and files a key-signed reading. Each epoch the auditor must wander a fixed route, re-measuring each plot: a missing reading, a copied cedar tag, or a twice-claimed plot burns the bond and voids the plot. The thousandth fake needs a fresh plot, tag, and 70 credits, so 1,000 fakes cost 110,000 for a 40,000-credit pool. An honest agent files once for 40 credits, keeping its seat.
